description: This file manages environment variables for shell processes, including resolving shell paths, reading system shells, and fallback mechanisms for environment variable setup, with functions for caching and platform-specific handling.

methods.name: resolveShellExecEnv
methods.description: Resolves the environment for executing a shell, ensuring HOME is set correctly and ZDOTDIR is removed.

methods.name: resolveTimeoutMs
methods.description: Determines the timeout in milliseconds, defaulting if input is invalid.

methods.name: readEtcShells
methods.description: Reads and caches the list of valid shells from /etc/shells.

methods.name: isTrustedShellPath
methods.description: Checks if a shell path is absolute, normalized, and registered in /etc/shells.

methods.name: resolveShell
methods.description: Resolves the shell path from environment, defaulting if not trusted.

methods.name: execLoginShellEnvZero
methods.description: Executes a login shell to retrieve environment variables.

methods.name: parseShellEnv
methods.description: Parses the output buffer from shell environment command into a key-value map.

methods.name: probeLoginShellEnv
methods.description: Probes the login shell environment, returning success or error.

methods.name: loadShellEnvFallback
methods.description: Loads environment variables fallback from login shell if enabled and necessary.

methods.name: shouldEnableShellEnvFallback
methods.description: Determines if shell environment fallback should be enabled based on environment variable.

methods.name: shouldDeferShellEnvFallback
methods.description: Determines if shell environment fallback should be deferred based on environment variable.

methods.name: resolveShellEnvFallbackTimeoutMs
methods.description: Resolves the timeout for shell environment fallback from environment variable.

methods.name: getShellPathFromLoginShell
methods.description: Retrieves the shell path from the login shell environment, with platform-specific handling.

methods.name: resetShellPathCacheForTests
methods.description: Resets cached shell path and /etc/shells list for testing purposes.

methods.name: getShellEnvAppliedKeys
methods.description: Returns the list of environment keys that were applied during fallback.
